import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

fig=make_subplots(rows=3,cols=4,
specs=[[{"type":"indicator"}]*4, [{"type":"xy"},{"type":"xy"},{"type":"domain"},{"type":"xy"}], [{"type":"xy"}]*4],
subplot_titles=("","","","","SALES BY CATEGORY","PROFIT BY CATEGORY","PAYMENT METHOD","CITY BY SALES","CITY BY PROFIT","MONTHLY SALES","SALES vs PROFIT","TOP 10 PRODUCTS"))
vals=[("TOTAL SALES",df["Sales"].sum()),("TOTAL PROFIT",df["Profit"].sum()),("TOTAL CUSTOMERS",df["Customer"].nunique()),("TOTAL ORDERS",df["Order_ID"].nunique())]

                                                                                                                            
for i,(t, v) in enumerate(vals, 1):
    fig.add_trace(go.Indicator(mode="number", value=v, title={"text":t}),row=1, col=i)
def add(f, r, c):
    [fig.add_trace(tr, row=r, col=c) for tr in f.data]
add(px.bar(df.groupby("Category", as_index=False)["Sales"].sum().sort_values("Sales", ascending=False), x="Category", y="Sales", color="Category"),2,1)
add(px.bar(df.groupby("Category", as_index=False)["Profit"].sum().sort_values("Profit", ascending=False), x="Category", y="Profit", color="Category"),2,2)
add(px.pie(df, names="Payment_Method", values="Sales", hole=0.5),2,3)
add(px.bar(df.groupby("City", as_index=False)["Sales"].sum().sort_values("Sales", ascending=False), x="City", y="Sales", color="City"),2,4)
add(px.bar(df.groupby("City", as_index=False)["Profit"].sum().sort_values("Profit", ascending=False), x="City", y="Profit", color="City"),3,1)
add(px.line(df.groupby("Month_Name",as_index=False)["Sales"].sum(),x="Month_Name",y="Sales",markers=True),3,2)
add(px.scatter(df,x="Sales",y="Profit",color="Category",hover_name="Customer"),3,3)
top=df.groupby("Product",as_index=False)["Sales"].sum().sort_values("Sales",ascending=False).head(10)
add(px.bar(top,x="Product",y="Sales",color="Sales"),3,4)




fig.update_layout(title={"text":"COMPANY SALES DAHSBOARD","x":0.5},template="plotly_dark",height=1000,width=1700,showlegend=False)
fig.show()

import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

fig = make_subplots(rows=4, cols=2,
specs=[[{"type": "xy"},{"type": "xy"}],[{"type":"domain"},{"type":"xy"}],
[{"type": "xy"},{"type": "xy"}],[{"type": "xy"},{"type": "domain"}]],
subplot_titles=("SALES BY CATEGORY", "MONTHLY SALES TREND","SALES BY CHANNEL", "SALES BY CUSTOMER TYPE",
"TOP 10 PRODUCTS", "SALES BY CITY","EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE", "SATISFACTION DISTRIBUTION"))

def add(f, r, c):
    [fig.add_trace(tr, row=r, col=c) for tr in f.data]

# Row 1
add(px.bar(df.groupby("Category", as_index=False)["Sales"].sum().sort_values("Sales", ascending=False).head(7),
x="Category", y="Sales"), 1, 1)

add(px.line(df.groupby("Month_Name", as_index=False)["Sales"].sum().head(5),
x="Month_Name", y="Sales"), 1, 2)

# Row 2
add(px.pie(df, names="City", values="Sales"), 2, 1)          # adjust column name

add(px.bar(df.groupby("Customer", as_index=False)["Sales"].sum(),
x="Customer", y="Sales"), 2, 2)                  # adjust column name

# Row 3
add(px.bar(df.groupby("Product", as_index=False)["Sales"].sum().sort_values("Sales", ascending=False).head(10),
x="Product", y="Sales"), 3, 1)                   # adjust column name

add(px.bar(df.groupby("City", as_index=False)["Sales"].sum(),
x="City", y="Sales"), 3, 2)                           # adjust column name

# Row 4
add(px.bar(df.groupby("Region", as_index=False)["Sales"].sum(),
x="Region", y="Sales"), 4, 1)                  # adjust column name

add(px.pie(df, names="Salesperson"), 4, 2)                   # adjust column name

fig.update_layout(title={"text": "DASHBOARD"},width=1100, height=1700,showlegend=False,template="plotly_dark")
fig.show()
